M3

 
 
 
M1 + Net time deposits of commercial banks

 
 
 

 
 
M4

 
 
 
M3 + Total deposits with Post Office savings organisations (excluding National Savings Certificates)

questions.question: Who among the following Mughal Emperors wrote his autobiography in Persian?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jahangir.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Tuzuk-e-Jahangiri (or Jahangirnama**

__
 
• **Tuzuk-e-Jahangiri or Jahangir-nama** is the **autobiography** **of** Mughal Emperor Nur-ud-din Muhammad **Jahangir** (1569–1627).
 
• It is written in **Persian** and follows the tradition of his great-grandfather, **Babur** (1487–1530), who had written the **Baburnama**. 
 
• The autobiography is a unique piece of literature that shows his power of expression and observation. 
 
• In it, he not only provided the history of his reign but also gave details viz. his perception of art, politics, and also information about his family.
 
• The Tuzuk-i-Jahangiri is the most important sourcebook for the reconstruction of the history of the Mughal empire in the reign of Jahangir.
 
• Jahangir twice mentions a tower, tank, and pavilion used as a hunting palace about 29 km from Lahore.
 
• Tuzuk is also a very important source for the history of the Mughal expansion in Bengal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** Akbar (1542-1605)**

• He was born on October **1542** and died on 27th October **1605**.
 
• In **1555**, Humayan died just months after retaking Delhi. Akbar ascended the Mughal throne at the **age of 13 and became Shahanshah ("King of Kings")**. 
 
• His regent was **Bayram Khan**, his **childhood guardian**, and an outstanding warrior/statesman.

• Man Singh: Mansabdar

• Abdul Rahim khan-i-khana: Statesman
 
• Mulla do Pyaza
 
 

​Babar (1**526-1530**)

 
• ​Babur is the founder of the Mughal Empire in India.
 
• His original name was **Zahiruddin Muhammad.**
 
• Baburnama, also known as **Tuzk-e Babri** is a biography of Babur written by him.
 
• **Humayun** was the **son of Babur.**

**Aurangzeb** **(1658-1707)**

 
• Aurangzeb was the sixth, and widely considered the last effective Mughal Emperor.

questions.question: In which of the following years was the ‘Caste Disabilities Act’ passed?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1850.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Caste Disabilities Removal Act:-**

 
 
• It was passed in the **year 1850** under the East India Company rule.
 
• The act **abolished all the laws affecting the rights of people converting to another caste or religion.**
 
• It **allowed equal rights under no law** to the Indians who converted to another religion.
 
• The new Act allowed Hindus who converted from the Hindu religion to another religion equal rights under the new law, especially in the case of inheritance.
 
• It **changed the Hindu Law of Property.**
 
• It **enabled a convert from Hinduism to another religion to inherit the property of his father.**
 
• The political situation got highly affected because of this Act as **it was seen as an incentive to give up one’s own faith.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

questions.question: Which element is generally NOT radioactive?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Germanium.**__

**__Explanation:__**

 
• A radioactive element is that which breaks down over time by turning into different elements and releasing energy.
 
• They are considered unstable since they have an unbalanced number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus. Germanium is not a radioactive element, while the rest of these are radioactive.

questions.question: In Indian Parliamentary System, Gram Panchayat is elected for how many years?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. __**Five years**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points____ **__

__
 
• **A Gram Panchayat **is the local-self-governance system formalized by the grassroots level of Panchayati Raj in India at a small-town or village level.
 
• **A Sarpanch **is its elected head. The term of the elected representatives in a Gram Panchayat is 5 years.
 
• There are three__ tiers in the Panchayati Raj structure.
 
 
• Gram Panchayat
 
• Zila Parishad
 
• Panchayat Samiti.
 
 
 
• **Gram Panchayat** is at the village level, **Panchayat Samiti **at the block level, and **Zila Parishad **at the district level.
 
• **A Gram Panchayat** covers one or more villages.
 
• Panchayat Samitis are indirectly elected bodies, in most cases.
 
• The jurisdiction of **Zila Parishad **extends over a district. The District collector heads the Zila Parishad at the district level.
 
• The Panchayati raj institutions were constitutionalized through the 73rd amendment Act 1992.
 
• Rajasthan was the first state to ratify and set up the Panchayati raj institution in the country.

questions.question: Under universal adult franchise, people of what age have the right to vote, irrespective of their social or economic backgrounds?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__18 years and above__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Universal adult franchise means that **all adults in the country are allowed to vote.**
 
• Universal suffrage: After independence, there was a need to hold general elections to elect a truly representative government on the basis of universal adult suffrage.
 
• **Article 325 **of the constitution ensures universal suffrage and provides that no person be ineligible for inclusion in, or to claim to be included in a special, electoral roll on **grounds of religion, race, caste, or sex.**
 
• Under the Universal Adult Franchise,** people who are 18 years old and above have the right to vote, irrespective of their social or economic backgrounds.**
 
• **The Sixty-first Amendment Act, of 1988,** lowered the voting age of elections to the Lok Sabha Legislative Assemblies of States from **21 years to 18 years.**
 
• The bill received presidential assent on 28th March 1989 when then President **R Venkataraman **assented to it.

questions.question: Calculate the time period (in seconds) of a sound wave of wavelength 4 m travelling with a speed of 500 m/s.
questions.solution:
• The distance covered by a point on the wave in unit time is the velocity of the sound wave.
 
• Any point on the sound wave covers a distance equal to λ (wavelength) in time T (time period).

Thus the velocity of sound is given by: V = λ/T

T = λ/V

Time = 4/500

Hence, Time Period will be 0.008 Seconds.

questions.question: Propagation of sound can be visualised as propagation of _______ variations in the medium.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• TYPE = “PASSWORD” is used to **display characters as asterisks in HTML.**
 
• **HyperText Markup Language**
 
 
• **Hypertext Markup Language** is the standard markup language for creating web pages and web applications.
 
• First developed by Tim Berners-Lee in 1990, HTML is short for Hypertext Markup Language.
 
• HTML is used to create electronic documents (called pages) that are displayed on the World Wide Web.
 
• It is a language used for writing source codes for developing a webpage, inserting content, and other components in it.
 
• HTML is a markup language because it is used to distinguish HTML elements from the text.
 
• HTML is not a programming language, meaning it doesn’t have the ability to create dynamic functionality. Instead, it makes it possible to organize and format documents, similar to Microsoft Word.
 
• When working with HTML, we use simple code structures (tags and attributes) to mark up a website page. For example, we can create a paragraph by placing the enclosed text within a starting *
* and closing *
* tag.
